blocks.explanation:
Yeh unit vectors ka scalar triple product hai, jawab ek number hoga.
Diya kya hai? \(2\underline{i} \times 2\underline{j} \cdot \underline{k}\).
Find kya karna hai? Is ki value.
Rule kaunsa? Pehle cross, phir dot; aur numbers (scalars) ko bahar nikal sakte hain.
Plan: \(2 \times 2 = 4\) bahar, phir \(\underline{i} \times \underline{j}\) aur us ka \(\underline{k}\) se dot.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(2\underline{i} \times 2\underline{j} \cdot \underline{k}\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki value.
Tareeqa: Is ka matlab \((2\underline{i} \times 2\underline{j}) \cdot \underline{k}\) hai, kyunke pehle dot karein to number ban jata, aur number ka cross ho nahi sakta. Numbers 2 aur 2 ko bahar nikal kar 4 bana lenge: \((m\underline{a}) \times (n\underline{b}) = mn(\underline{a} \times \underline{b})\).

Hal karein
\[(2\underline{i} \times 2\underline{j}) \cdot \underline{k} = 4(\underline{i} \times \underline{j}) \cdot \underline{k}\]
\[= 4\,\underline{k} \cdot \underline{k} = 4(1) = 4\]
Kyun: \(\underline{i}, \underline{j}, \underline{k}\) ek daire (cycle) mein chalte hain: \(\underline{i} \to \underline{j} \to \underline{k} \to \underline{i}\). Daire ki seedhi tarteeb mein cross product agla unit vector deta hai: \(\underline{i} \times \underline{j} = \underline{k}\), \(\underline{j} \times \underline{k} = \underline{i}\), \(\underline{k} \times \underline{i} = \underline{j}\). Aur kisi unit vector ka apne aap se dot product 1 hai, kyunke angle 0 aur lambai 1 hai.

Tasdeeq
\[[\underline{i}\ \underline{j}\ \underline{k}] = 1 \Rightarrow 4[\underline{i}\ \underline{j}\ \underline{k}] = 4 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \((\underline{i} \times \underline{j}) \cdot \underline{k}\) dar asal \([\underline{i}\ \underline{j}\ \underline{k}]\) hai, jo ek unit cube (1 by 1 by 1 ka dabba) ka volume hai, yani 1. Us ka 4 guna 4.

blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi unit vectors ka triple product hai.
Diya kya hai? \(3\underline{j} \cdot \underline{k} \times \underline{i}\).
Find kya karna hai? Is ki value.
Rule kaunsa? Pehle \(\underline{k} \times \underline{i}\), phir \(3\underline{j}\) ke saath dot.
Plan: daire wala qaida lagayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(3\underline{j} \cdot \underline{k} \times \underline{i}\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki value.
Tareeqa: Is ka matlab \(3\underline{j} \cdot (\underline{k} \times \underline{i})\) hai; cross hamesha pehle.

Hal karein
\[\underline{k} \times \underline{i} = \underline{j}\]
\[3\underline{j} \cdot \underline{j} = 3(1) = 3\]
Kyun: \(\underline{i}, \underline{j}, \underline{k}\) ek daire (cycle) mein chalte hain: \(\underline{i} \to \underline{j} \to \underline{k} \to \underline{i}\). Daire ki seedhi tarteeb mein cross product agla unit vector deta hai: \(\underline{i} \times \underline{j} = \underline{k}\), \(\underline{j} \times \underline{k} = \underline{i}\), \(\underline{k} \times \underline{i} = \underline{j}\). Aur kisi unit vector ka apne aap se dot product 1 hai, kyunke angle 0 aur lambai 1 hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\underline{k} \times \underline{i}\) ko \(-\underline{j}\) likhna aam ghalti hai; \(\underline{k} \to \underline{i}\) daire ki seedhi tarteeb hai, is liye plus.

Tasdeeq
\[3[\underline{j}\ \underline{k}\ \underline{i}] = 3[\underline{i}\ \underline{j}\ \underline{k}] = 3 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\underline{j}, \underline{k}, \underline{i}\) asal mein \(\underline{i}, \underline{j}, \underline{k}\) ko daire mein aage khiskana hai, aur cyclic property kehti hai is se value nahi badalti.

blocks.explanation:
Bracket \([\underline{a}\ \underline{b}\ \underline{c}]\) ka matlab \(\underline{a} \cdot (\underline{b} \times \underline{c})\) hai.
Diya kya hai? \([\underline{k}\ \underline{i}\ \underline{j}]\).
Find kya karna hai? Is ki value.
Rule kaunsa? Bracket ko dot aur cross mein khol kar daire wala qaida.
Plan: \(\underline{k} \cdot (\underline{i} \times \underline{j})\) nikalna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \([\underline{k}\ \underline{i}\ \underline{j}]\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki value.
Tareeqa: \([\underline{k}\ \underline{i}\ \underline{j}] = \underline{k} \cdot (\underline{i} \times \underline{j})\): pehla vector dot, baqi do ka cross.

Hal karein
\[\underline{i} \times \underline{j} = \underline{k}\]
\[\underline{k} \cdot \underline{k} = 1\]
Kyun: \(\underline{i}, \underline{j}, \underline{k}\) ek daire (cycle) mein chalte hain: \(\underline{i} \to \underline{j} \to \underline{k} \to \underline{i}\). Daire ki seedhi tarteeb mein cross product agla unit vector deta hai: \(\underline{i} \times \underline{j} = \underline{k}\), \(\underline{j} \times \underline{k} = \underline{i}\), \(\underline{k} \times \underline{i} = \underline{j}\). Aur kisi unit vector ka apne aap se dot product 1 hai, kyunke angle 0 aur lambai 1 hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\begin{vmatrix} 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \end{vmatrix} = 1(1 - 0) = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\underline{k} = [0, 0, 1]\), \(\underline{i} = [1, 0, 0]\), \(\underline{j} = [0, 1, 0]\) ko rows bana kar determinant liya. Pehli row mein sirf teesri entry 1 hai, us ka minor \((1)(1) - (0)(0) = 1\). Wohi jawab.

blocks.explanation:
Is triple product mein ek vector \(\underline{i}\) do dafa aaya hai.
Diya kya hai? \([\underline{i}\ \underline{i}\ \underline{k}]\).
Find kya karna hai? Is ki value.
Rule kaunsa? \(\underline{i} \cdot (\underline{i} \times \underline{k})\), aur yaad rakhein ke cross product dono vectors ke perpendicular hota hai.
Plan: \(\underline{i} \times \underline{k}\) nikal kar \(\underline{i}\) se dot.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \([\underline{i}\ \underline{i}\ \underline{k}]\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki value.
Tareeqa: \([\underline{i}\ \underline{i}\ \underline{k}] = \underline{i} \cdot (\underline{i} \times \underline{k})\).

Hal karein
\[\underline{i} \times \underline{k} = -\underline{j}\]
\[\underline{i} \cdot (-\underline{j}) = 0\]
Kyun: Daire mein \(\underline{k} \to \underline{i}\) seedhi tarteeb hai, is liye \(\underline{k} \times \underline{i} = \underline{j}\); hum ne ulti tarteeb \(\underline{i} \times \underline{k}\) li, to sign badal kar \(-\underline{j}\). Phir \(\underline{i}\) aur \(\underline{j}\) aapas mein perpendicular (90 degree) hain, aur perpendicular vectors ka dot product 0 hota hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Jis determinant ki do rows barabar hon, us ki value 0 hoti hai. Yaad rakhne wali baat: jab triple product mein koi vector dohraya jaye to jawab hamesha 0, kyunke do hi asal directions hain aur dabba chapta ho jata hai. Exam mein yeh pehchan lein to hisaab ki zaroorat hi nahi.

blocks.explanation:
Yeh proof hai, aur is ki chaabi scalar triple product ki cyclic property hai.
Diya kya hai? Koi bhi teen vectors \(\underline{u}, \underline{v}, \underline{w}\).
Saabit kya karna hai? Left side ke teeno terms mil kar \(3\underline{u} \cdot (\underline{v} \times \underline{w})\) bante hain.
Rule kaunsa? Cyclic property: vectors ko daire mein aage khiskane se triple product nahi badalta.
Plan: doosre aur teesre term ko \([\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\) ki shakal mein laana, phir jama karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: koi bhi teen vectors \(\underline{u}, \underline{v}, \underline{w}\).
Humein saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= 3\underline{u} \cdot (\underline{v} \times \underline{w})\).
Tareeqa: Cyclic property: \([\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}] = [\underline{v}\ \underline{w}\ \underline{u}] = [\underline{w}\ \underline{u}\ \underline{v}]\). Kyun? Teeno ek hi dabbe (parallelepiped) ka volume hain; edges ko kis kone se ginna shuru karein, dabba wohi rehta hai, bas tarteeb daire mein honi chahiye.

Har term ko bracket mein likhein
\[\underline{v} \cdot (\underline{w} \times \underline{u}) = [\underline{v}\ \underline{w}\ \underline{u}]\]
\[\underline{w} \cdot (\underline{u} \times \underline{v}) = [\underline{w}\ \underline{u}\ \underline{v}]\]
Kyun: Definition se \(\underline{a} \cdot (\underline{b} \times \underline{c}) = [\underline{a}\ \underline{b}\ \underline{c}]\): pehla vector dot wala, baqi do cross wale.

Cyclic property lagayein
\[[\underline{v}\ \underline{w}\ \underline{u}] = [\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\]
\[[\underline{w}\ \underline{u}\ \underline{v}] = [\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\]
Kyun: \(\underline{u} \to \underline{v} \to \underline{w} \to \underline{u}\) ke daire mein \(\underline{v}, \underline{w}, \underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{w}, \underline{u}, \underline{v}\) dono seedhi tarteeb hain. Determinant ki zabaan mein: rows ko daire mein ek qadam khiskana do row swaps ke barabar hai, aur do dafa sign badalne se sign wapas wohi ho jata hai.
Dhyan dein: Agar tarteeb ulti ho, jaise \([\underline{v}\ \underline{u}\ \underline{w}]\), to sign badal jata hai; woh \(-[\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\) hota.

Teeno terms jama karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = [\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}] + [\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}] + [\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\]
\[= 3[\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\]
\[= 3\underline{u} \cdot (\underline{v} \times \underline{w}) = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: Teen barabar numbers ka jama un mein se ek ka teen guna hota hai, jaise \(5 + 5 + 5 = 3 \times 5\).

Numbers se tasdeeq
\[\underline{u} = \underline{i},\ \underline{v} = \underline{j},\ \underline{w} = \underline{k}:\]
\[1 + 1 + 1 = 3 = 3(1) \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\underline{i} \cdot (\underline{j} \times \underline{k}) = \underline{j} \cdot (\underline{k} \times \underline{i}) = \underline{k} \cdot (\underline{i} \times \underline{j}) = 1\). Ek misaal proof nahi hoti, lekin yeh dikhati hai ke hamari baat sahi simt mein hai.
